## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `MetricsPrometheusGrafana`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `metrics-prometheus-grafana`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **MetricsPrometheusGrafana**.

## Step 2: Data Source Configuration

1. <!-- manual: In Grafana, navigate to Configuration › Data Sources -->
2. <!-- manual: Add a Prometheus data source pointing to your Prometheus server -->
3. <!-- manual: Set the URL (e.g., http://prometheus:9090) -->
